scripts.rebuild:android: npm run clean && npm run ensure:8081 && cross-env EXPO_DEBUG=1 RCT_METRO_PORT=8081 expo run:android --port 8081

scripts.start: npm run ensure:8081 && cross-env RCT_METRO_PORT=8081 expo start --dev-client --lan --port 8081
scripts.start:verbose: npm run ensure:8081 && cross-env EXPO_DEBUG=1 RCT_METRO_PORT=8081 expo start --dev-client --lan --port 8081
scripts.start:tunnel: npm run ensure:8081 && cross-env RCT_METRO_PORT=8081 expo start --dev-client --tunnel --port 8081
scripts.start:localhost: npm run ensure:8081 && cross-env REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1 RCT_METRO_PORT=8081 expo start --dev-client --localhost --port 8081
